entries.text: Players can now manually add logs to campfires, thus keeping the fire alive
Add a button to reset graphic settings to default in case the player enters an invalid screen configuration
Nerf whisker population tax from 5 to 3 per whisker per day in normal difficulty
Nerf pollution generated by all heaters by half
Reduce production tax by 33% across all difficulties
Improve mine tool behavior when mining floors
Make the stone paths related quest require a schematic check, and randomize the start day
Make the 89 whisker population quest from Claws trigger randomly, and after the second year
Increased the priority of harvesting crops
Increased the recovery speed of soil nutrients
Cold temperatures no longer slow down or stop nutrient recovery
Increased the yield of unfertilized crops. Fertilizer boost is reduced to 150%, but due to the overall increase, fertilized crops yield the same as before
Fully grown crops no longer drain nutrients
Farmers now always fertilize crops when sowing, provided the fertilizer is stocked and available.
Add graceful reloading of prior floating point error caused corrupted save files
Speed up stone mining by 40%
Make main island size parameters more extreme, big is larger and small is tiny’er.
Reduce embark ship tax cost
Boost spawn rate of educated whiskers by 61%
Claws will no longer offer technology that is already being researched
Increased the speed of nutrient consumption by crops
Tax payments now support shift/ctrl/alt hotkeys for increments of 5/25/99
Optimized the loading time when recovering corrupted saves
Add Overtime toggle. After activating overtime, you can now toggle it to automatically renew as long as you have enough Approval.
Reduce Admin tax by 8 per day
Increase the capacity of all warehouses by about 60%
Snow now appears on ground at 0 degrees celsius
Boost steam radiator range by 70%
Boost heater range by 10%
Add overtime & pause functionality to the Logistics Hub
Display warning when Earthworks Camp has no designated cells in range

Shrink max work range of the farm building by 15%

Add Pollution overlay
Make building range indicator easier to see over snow

Beach and ocean floor fertility is now driven by groundwater salinity, which permeates through sandy ground. Terraforming blocks salinity flow and drained ocean floor is often quite fertile after salinity has fallen enough.
Increase terrain survey depth to 2 cells
Farmers will now sow after tilling on fields with rock removal active, if there are no more rocks to remove
Farmers will never sow a field with rock removal active if there are still rocks to remove
Adjusted internal priorities of some farm tasks
Add variant of Steam Booster with opposite launch direction
Replacing flooring type will no longer remove path decoratives

New visuals for several resource types
Increase range construction workers can travel
Increase default fire tender range by 50%

Add a global mechanic to block Whiskers from eating in warehouses. Behaviour toggleable at any Cafe or Dining Hall

Add new policy “Reckless Navigation” to boost raft speeds
Added 1 new ‘Small Planter’ decorative variant: flax plant
Update all localizations, thank you translators!

Use signed distance field driven visuals for navigation blockers.

Boost speed of Splitters by 25%
